category.description: Classification category; the attribute comment identifies its classification machine tag.

classification.description: Full ptrclassify taxonomy machine tag for a matched label. Related classification fields use this tag as their attribute comment.

classification-description.description: Explanation of a classification; the attribute comment identifies its classification machine tag.

classifier-version.description: Version of the ptrclassify library used for classification.

cloud-region.description: Cloud region inferred from the hostname; not verified geolocation.

confidence.description: Classification confidence from 0 to 1; the attribute comment identifies its classification machine tag.

conflict.description: Conflicting classification labels reported by the classifier.

embedded-ip.description: IPv4 address found encoded in the hostname.

evidence.description: Matched text supporting a classification; the attribute comment identifies its classification machine tag.

ip.description: Queried IPv4 or IPv6 address used as context for classification.

label.description: Classification label; the attribute comment identifies its classification machine tag.

location-city.description: Possible city; the attribute comment identifies the candidate by its rule ID and code. Location hints are heuristic, not verified geolocation.

location-code.description: Original geographic code; the attribute comment identifies the candidate by its rule ID and code. Location hints are heuristic, not verified geolocation.

location-confidence.description: Location confidence from 0 to 1; the attribute comment identifies the candidate by its rule ID and code. Location hints are heuristic, not verified geolocation.

location-country.description: Possible ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country; the attribute comment identifies the candidate by its rule ID and code. Location hints are heuristic, not verified geolocation.

location-description.description: Explanation and limitations of the location hint; the attribute comment identifies the candidate by its rule ID and code. Location hints are heuristic, not verified geolocation.

location-evidence.description: Matched text supporting the location; the attribute comment identifies the candidate by its rule ID and code. Location hints are heuristic, not verified geolocation.

location-region.description: Possible region; the attribute comment identifies the candidate by its rule ID and code. Location hints are heuristic, not verified geolocation.

location-rule-id.description: Rule producing the location; the attribute comment identifies the candidate by its rule ID and code. Location hints are heuristic, not verified geolocation.

matched.description: Whether at least one classification label matched this hostname.

rule-id.description: Rule producing a classification; the attribute comment identifies its classification machine tag.

description: Heuristic classification of one PTR-style hostname, including labels, confidence, evidence, rule IDs and potential location hints. Repeated classification fields are grouped by machine-tag comments; location fields are grouped by rule-ID/code comments. PTR names are operator-controlled and inferred locations are not verified geolocation.
name: ptrclassify
